@oceannigger: after installing .NET Core 2 you have to execute these commands (skip the steps you have already done, you have probably already cloned Voat):

export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 # Optional, in case you don't want to send telemetry data to Microsoft when you build Voat
git clone https://github.com/voat/voat
cd voat
dotnet build

That should be enough to build Voat, you'll have to initialize the database later (create a new one in PostgreSQL and execute the SQL scripts in voat/misc/SqlScripts/PostgreSql in this order: voat.sql, voat_users.sql, procedures.sql, data.sql) and configure Voat (cp voat/src/Voat.UI/~appsettings.json voat/src/Voat.UI/appsettings.json and update the database config in that file with your database info). Also don't forget to install Redis, Voat needs it for its cache. Finally do cd src/Voat.UI/ and dotnet run. I may have missed a few steps, it's been a month or two since the last time I tried this. In case something doesn't work as expected message me.
